style: Cheerful picture-book look for a kindergarten feelings lesson: soft round shapes, warm friendly colors, faces that read clearly from the back of a classroom.

assets.name: studio
assets.prompt: Empty background: a cozy, colorful children's TV weather studio seen straight on at a child's eye level. A curved back wall in soft teal and sunny yellow with round studio lights along the top, a few potted plants and a little wooden stool at the far right, a smooth wooden floor. The left two thirds of the back wall is plain and empty (a big blank wall area, nothing hanging on it). No screens, no people, no animals, no writing, no letters. 16:9.

assets.name: land
assets.prompt: A wide gentle countryside view for a weather map: rolling green hills, a little red-roofed town with a few houses and a school, a winding river, round trees and a farm field, seen from slightly above. Bright and simple. The whole sky, everything above the far hills (the top half of the picture), is one perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF), with no clouds, sun or birds. Keep that magenta out of the hills, roofs and trees.

assets.name: bear-happy
assets.prompt: A friendly young brown bear cub who is a TV weather reporter, wearing a little blue vest and a red bow tie, holding a small microphone in one paw. Feeling HAPPY: a big warm smile, bright eyes, standing tall. Full body from head to feet, standing, front view turned slightly to the left.

assets.name: bear-sad
assets.prompt: The same bear cub reporter, same outfit and microphone. Feeling SAD: eyebrows tilted up in the middle, mouth turned down, one small tear on the cheek, shoulders drooping, ears low. Full body from head to feet, standing, front view turned slightly to the left.

assets.name: bear-angry
assets.prompt: The same bear cub reporter, same outfit and microphone. Feeling ANGRY: eyebrows pulled down hard, frowning mouth, red cheeks, fists clenched, stamping one foot. Cartoon angry, not scary. Full body from head to feet, standing, front view turned slightly to the left.

assets.name: bear-scared
assets.prompt: The same bear cub reporter, same outfit and microphone. Feeling SCARED: wide eyes, eyebrows up, small open mouth, paws pulled up close to the chest, knees together, leaning back. Full body from head to feet, standing, front view turned slightly to the left.

assets.name: bear-worried
assets.prompt: The same bear cub reporter, same outfit and microphone. Feeling WORRIED: eyebrows pinched together and up, a small wobbly mouth, biting the lip a little, one paw rubbing the other arm. Full body from head to feet, standing, front view turned slightly to the left.

assets.name: bear-confused
assets.prompt: The same bear cub reporter, same outfit and microphone. Feeling CONFUSED: one eyebrow up and one down, mouth pushed to one side, head tilted, scratching the head with one paw. Full body from head to feet, standing, front view turned slightly to the left.

assets.name: bear-excited
assets.prompt: The same bear cub reporter, same outfit and microphone. Feeling EXCITED: huge open smile, sparkling eyes, jumping up with both feet off the ground and one arm thrown up high. Full body from head to feet, front view turned slightly to the left.

assets.name: bear-calm
assets.prompt: The same bear cub reporter, same outfit and microphone. Feeling CALM: eyes gently closed, a soft small smile, relaxed shoulders, one paw resting on the tummy, taking a slow deep breath. Full body from head to feet, standing, front view turned slightly to the left.

assets.name: bear-proud
assets.prompt: The same bear cub reporter, same outfit and microphone. Feeling PROUD: chin up, chest out, a confident closed-mouth smile, one paw on the hip. Full body from head to feet, standing, front view turned slightly to the left.
